title: M2 (CH264) J1 window-time extractor and blind follow-up recorder pass (MEASUREMENT_M2_CH264.md 9.2): one idempotent chronological pass that folds the 84-slot look-back and the window, decides each slot at grid + 6 h by the manifest's finished_utc, writes write-once units/, status/, nofav/ and followup/ files and the state file; recurring cron entry below, from the first pass after REGISTERED_UTC until the follow-up closes
expected_value: the unit set and the blind follow-up of the prospective measurement; snapshots are kept about 8 days so a missed pass is recoverable only within retention (a slot with no on-time capture at grid + 6 h is recorded missing_capture with its own status file, never rebuilt)
data: host originals ~/arepo/data-dumps/research_lab/snapshots and stream_gamma_rules (read-only); writes data-dumps/research_lab/m2_ch264/
outputs: data-dumps/research_lab/m2_ch264/units/, status/, nofav/, followup/, state.json, logs/j1_runs.jsonl
next_action: run again 2 h later through the window (END_UTC 2026-12-15T00:00Z, last window slot decided 2026-12-15T04:31Z) and on to the read-out (the follow-up recorder writes until READOUT_UTC 2027-01-29T00:00Z; its last slot is decided 2027-01-29T04:31Z); then q0755b_m2_j2 and q0755c_m2_j2_followup
notes: DRAFT (not in jobs/; register only after the registration commit, which must be at least 24 h before REGISTERED_UTC 2026-11-24T00:00Z). A queue 'repeat' would re-queue at once and spin, so the recurring mechanism is a cron entry in the style of M1's q0751 (not added here): `50 */2 * * * cd ~/arepo/backend && flock -n ~/arepo/run/m2_j1.lock nice -n 19 sh -c 'echo 1000 > /proc/self/oom_score_adj; ulimit -v 1572864; ../.venv/bin/python scripts/run_m2.py j1 --store ../data-dumps/research_lab/m2_ch264 --snapshot-root ../data-dumps/research_lab/snapshots --rules-root ../data-dumps/research_lab/stream_gamma_rules --pins ../docs/research_lab/seals/M2_pins.json' >> ~/arepo/run/m2_j1.log 2>&1` (minute 50 of even hours, after the host's pass and apart from M1's :20 pass; a separate lock). not_before 2026-11-24T00:50Z: the code itself refuses before REGISTERED_UTC (exit 2, nothing written), so the cron line may be installed earlier; the first pass at or after REGISTERED_UTC folds the fixed look-back span [REGISTERED_UTC - 7 d, REGISTERED_UTC) (84 slots, a missing one counted missing_lookback_slot) and every decidable slot after it. A slot is decided only once now >= grid + 6 h, by the manifest's finished_utc <= grid + 6 h (a manifest without finished_utc is not on time); k - 1 is the capture the chain folded; late, duplicate and off-grid captures get write-once side status files; the state file is JSON lines whose sha256 is chained through the status files. --pins (the registration commit's M2_pins.json: spec_sha, code_sha, registration_commit_utc; manifest hashes are added after J2) is required and the running code must equal it at every pass; J1 refuses once followup_manifest.json exists (remove the cron entry then). The window close does not stop J1: it keeps folding and recording the blind follow-up to READOUT_UTC. Do not run concurrently with a multi-GB job (memory rule); planned peak RSS 300-500 MB, cap 600 MB (measured by q0754). Code: backend/scripts/run_m2.py with astrolabe/research_lab/m2_spec.py, m2_j1.py, m2_j2.py, m2_readout.py, m2_analysis.py (code_sha in the unit lines); pins checked at start (exit 3 with expected and actual values on a mismatch, exit 2 on a declared refusal).
